one_liner: A simple leaf app that plays a bend animation on a skinned mesh rig; currently lacks interactive click handling.
primary_use_case: Play a predefined bend animation on a leaf model, useful for decorative or environmental effects.
preview_recommendation: No preview media is attached; create a screenshot or short video showing the leaf bending animation and, if possible, a UI element for interaction.
manifest_quality_notes: App cannot be selected or duplicated via right‑click due to skinned mesh limitations.
Suggested to add an invisible collider node to capture click events.
Script is minimal and safe, but lacks UI for user interaction.
Model size is small (~57 KB) and script is tiny (56 bytes).
